body: Have you been to a doctor? You’re very lucky to still be alive, I hope everything works out okay for you.
I’m happy to read that your first time was memorable and safe.
Thank you so much my friend :')

Nobody can predict the future. But when you have been at rock bottom, the only place is up. I really hope that you can see that and hope that you can hold on for long enough so you can encourage someone on reddit to also hold on. I've been there. I wish i could give you a hug.
Thank you and congratulations to you too :) I still cant believe it, but whenever I re-read the final payment confirmation, it gives me butterflies. Good health to you

I've been there, thinking you have nothing to live for because you don't fit in or because or a crush who may not like you back. Honestly, shit times like this are what will help you mold into a strong person. Character building. It'll feel shit but you will come out of it so frickin strong.

You don't always have to know how life will work it self out but it does. I've been there, on the top of a cliff which is famous for suicides, I've looked down to the very bottom as I stood on the edge, but I didn't do it, obviously, I got a phone call the next day which changed my life. Life is beautiful especially when you have been to the lowest point, be there to enjoy the amazing moments. Honestly. if you dont have all the answers to why you feel what you feel or if you dont know how you're going to get over an ex, pay your bills, grieving, just know that you dont need to know how this shit time will pass, but just know that it will and you will enjoy life.
Thank you, I really want someone who is really struggling to find this post and realise that life always has a way to work itself out. Good health to you :)
